question: A Legacy Meridian-7 site is congested — should I load-balance or reroute traffic to relieve it?
reference_answer: No — on Meridian-7 sites, load-balancing during congestion triggers a firmware race condition causing a full site reset. Throttle new session admission instead.

question: A site with an Aurora-series antenna array shows high latency with no packet loss — should I restart the backhaul link?
reference_answer: No — this is caused by a beamforming recalibration loop specific to Aurora arrays; restarting backhaul makes it worse. Do a manual beamform reset instead.

question: DNS resolution is failing on a Continuum core platform site — will failing over to the secondary resolver fix it?
reference_answer: No — the secondary resolver shares the same zone file replication bug as primary. Flush the local zone cache on the site controller instead.

question: A Titan-series baseband unit shows packet loss under 5% — should I swap the transceiver?
reference_answer: No — this is caused by an internal packet-scheduler buffer pre-allocation bug, not the transceiver. Do a soft reboot of the packet scheduler process instead.

question: A Solstice VPN gateway keeps failing tunnel renegotiation and it looks like certificate expiry — should I renew the certificates first?
reference_answer: No — this is a known NTP daemon bug on Solstice gateways that mimics cert expiry. Restart the NTP daemon before touching certificates.

question: Meridian-link paired cells are having a handover failure event right now — should I adjust the neighbor-cell-relation thresholds to fix it?
reference_answer: No — adjusting NCR thresholds during an active event triggers an oscillation bug that worsens it. Freeze NCR changes and wait 90 seconds for the automatic recovery timer.
